AEE.caption: Sources
AEE.doc: The PDFs to merge, in order. Key: the type (submission, combined_pdf, template, custom_file or url). Value: its ID, or the URL for url.
AEE.name: sources

AEF.caption: Sources (JSON)
AEF.doc: Optional, advanced. A JSON list of sources added after Sources, such as [{"type": "template", "id": "tpl_123", "template_version": "1.2.0"}].
AEF.name: sourcesJson

AEG.caption: Metadata
AEG.doc: Your own data about the record, such as an ID from your app. It isn't printed on the PDF, and it's sent with webhooks.
AEG.name: metadata

AEH.caption: PDF Password
AEH.doc: Optional. A password that the PDF needs to be opened with. DocSpring never returns it.
AEH.name: password

AEI.caption: Expires In (Seconds)
AEI.doc: Optional. Seconds after the PDF is generated until DocSpring deletes it and its data, up to 10 years (315360000). Default: the template's expiration setting.
AEI.name: expiresIn

AEJ.caption: Wait
AEJ.doc: Wait up to 45 seconds for the combined PDF. Turn it off to return straight away.
AEJ.name: wait
